description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Serializer,' which manages caching of definition data by serializing it to files, including functionalities such as add, set, get, remove, flush, and cleanup of cache files.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Serializer
classes.description: A class that serializes and manages cache files for definitions in the HTML Purifier library, providing methods to add, set, get, remove, flush, and clean cache-related files based on configuration.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a definition to the cache by serializing and saving it to a generated file path if the definition type is valid and the file doesn't already exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or updates a cached definition by serializing it to the designated file path.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces an existing cached definition after verifying its existence.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached definition by deserializing data from the corresponding file.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Deletes all files in the cache directory.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes old cache files based on age criteria.

methods.name: generateFilePath
methods.description: Generates the file path for a given configuration's cache file.

methods.name: generateDirectoryPath
methods.description: Generates the directory path where cache files are stored for a given configuration.

methods.name: generateBaseDirectoryPath
methods.description: Generates the base directory path for all cache serials, based on configuration or default prefix.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: A wrapper for file_put_contents, writes data to a file.

methods.name: _prepareDir
methods.description: Prepares the cache directory, creating it if necessary and checking permissions.

methods.name: _testPermissions
methods.description: Tests the permissions of a directory and attempts to fix them if writable issues are detected.
